excerpt.zh: 这颗小行星的轨道上运行着一个小型空间站。似乎已经废弃。
excerpt.en: A small space station of some kind has been built in a stable orbit around this asteroid. It appears deserted.

texts.zh: 这颗小行星的轨道上运行着一个小型空间站。似乎已经废弃。
texts.en: A small space station of some kind has been built in a stable orbit around this asteroid. It appears deserted.

sections.zh: 这颗小行星的轨道上运行着一个小型空间站。似乎已经废弃。
sections.en: A small space station of some kind has been built in a stable orbit around this asteroid. It appears deserted.

texts.zh: 我们在[From.GetName]的近地轨道探测到一座自动采矿基地。其表面有小型武器留下的灼烧痕迹，而且该设施似乎陷入了死循环。我们已经重编译了基地系统，现在我们已完全控制该设施。
texts.en: We have detected an automated mining base built in close orbit around asteroid [From.GetName]. There is scorching on the hull indicative of light weapons damage, and the facility appeared to be stuck in some kind of feedback loop. We have managed to reprogram the base systems and the facility is now fully under our control.

texts.zh: 我们在[From.GetName]的近地轨道探测到一座自动采矿基地。其表面存在大块缺失，这些呈现锯齿状的大洞表明该船曾遭受重型武器的攻击，现已无法修复。但仍有宝贵的材料可以回收。
texts.en: We have detected an automated mining base built in close orbit around asteroid [From.GetName]. There are large chunks of the hull missing, the jagged holes indicative of heavy weapons damage. The station is beyond repair, but salvaging it will provide us with valuable materials.

texts.zh: 我们错了。这座围绕[From.GetName]的空间站并非无人居住；相反，它上面爬满了巨大的外星节肢动物！我们部署进空间站的传感器在信号中断前只回传了一些行动迅捷的阴影和巨大颚骨的画面。在对空间站进行深度扫描后，我们发现了一处可能是无比复杂的数据库的地方。为了抵达这座数据库，我们需要穿过这些一团团的、有好多腿儿的守护者。
texts.en: We were wrong. The station orbiting [From.GetName] is not uninhabited; instead, it is crawling with giant alien arthropoids! The probes we deployed into the station only returned skittering shadows and large mandibles before signal was lost. Deep scans of the station have also revealed what we postulate to be an incredibly complex databank. To reach this databank, we would have to go through that cluster of many-legged defenders.

label.zh: 送客，巨大的外星节肢动物可不是闹着玩的！
label.en: Send an away party, giant alien arthropoids are no joke!

label.zh: 也许我们最好还是不要打扰他们。
label.en: It's probably for the best that we leave them alone.

label.zh: 尝试与这些节肢动物小伙伴联络。
label.en: Attempt to contact our fellow arthropoids.

tooltips.zh: 用我们对居住站的先进知识让空间站的大气层裂一个口子。
tooltips.en: Use our advance knowledge of habitats to breach the station's atmosphere.

notes.zh: 选项a内部是 random_list：50% 杀死一名科学家，50% 获得或推进超空间引擎科技（anomaly_events_4.txt:2475-2505 附近）。
notes.en: Option a contains a random_list: 50% a scientist is killed, 50% hyperdrive tech is granted or advanced (around anomaly_events_4.txt:2475-2505).

texts.zh: 噢，你们好！很抱歉之前摧毁了你们的探测器。那只是因为我们在这做一些非常精密的实验，而我们担心一些外在的干扰会影响实验结果——我相信你能理解。那么，我们能帮上什么忙吗？
texts.en: Oh, hello there! Sorry about destroying your probe earlier. It's just that we are conducting some very delicate experiments here, and we were worried that outside interference could alter the results - I'm sure you understand. Now, how can we help you?

label.zh: 慢着，所以你们并不是带有敌意的害虫？
label.en: Wait, so you are not a hostile infestation?

texts.zh: 究竟是什么原因会让你这么想啊？我们是一支策展人分遣队，派驻到这里研究这个恒星系独特的特征。如果你是想分享我们机构通常给予的那些福利，我建议你和我们的主研究实验室联系。我可以提供你一份目前我们在此地所发现的东西的拷贝。
texts.en: What would ever give you that impression? We are a Curator detachment sent here to study this system's unique properties. If you wish to partake of our order's usual offerings, I suggest contacting the primary research lab. I can provide you with a copy of our findings so far.

summary.text:
# 废弃空间站 / Abandoned Station

- 分类 Category：深空异闻 Exploration · 审阅 Reviewed：2026-10-13（已审阅 reviewed）
- 来源 Sources：common/anomalies/00_anomaly_categories.txt:166; events/anomaly_events_1.txt:285 (anomaly.40); events/anomaly_events_4.txt:2464 (anomaly.6810); events/anomaly_events_4.txt:2572 (anomaly.6815); events/anomaly_events_4.txt:2640 (anomaly.6820)

## 如何开始 How it starts

有矿物的小行星可能生成（3级，权重3，全局一次 max_once）。

Can spawn on an asteroid with minerals (level 3, weight 3, once per game via max_once).

## 剧情脉络 Story outline

两个结果各占50%。anomaly.40“自动采矿基地”：若该小行星在帝国边境外，按它的矿物/能量资源给每月矿物或能量加成；若在边境内，则直接建立采矿站。anomaly.6810“感染”：a 随机（各50%）杀死一名科学家或获得超空间引擎科技进度；b 获得50影响力；c（需要利维坦或遥远繁星 DLC、机械物种（ART）、非杀戮帝国、系统无特殊标志）创建巨型外星策展人并进入 anomaly.6815“巨大外星节肢动物”→ anomaly.6820（建立与策展人飞地的联络、超空间引擎科技、标本 curator_survey）；d（虚空居民起源或有 tech_habitat_1）直接获得超空间引擎科技；演化掠食者另有 DNA 选项。

Two results, 50% each. anomaly.40 "Automated Mining Base": outside the empire's borders it grants monthly minerals or energy depending on the asteroid's resources; inside borders it builds a mining station. anomaly.6810 "Infestation": a random 50/50 between killing a scientist and progress toward hyperdrive tech; b 50 influence; c (needs Leviathans or Distant Stars, a robotic species, non-homicidal, and no special system flag) creates giant alien curators and continues to anomaly.6815 "The Giant Alien Arthropoids" then anomaly.6820 (contact with the curator enclave, hyperdrive tech, specimen curator_survey); d (Void Dweller origin or tech_habitat_1) hyperdrive tech directly; Evolutionary Predators get an extra DNA option.

## 分支与结局 Branches and outcomes

两个起始结果互斥；6810 的选项是并列选择，只有选项c延伸到 6815→6820 的策展人线。

The starting results are exclusive; 6810's options are alternatives and only option c continues into the 6815 -> 6820 curator line.

## 条件与文明差异 Conditions and variants

anomaly.40 的描述与选项按小行星是否在帝国边境内变化；6810 的选项c/d受 DLC、物种类别、起源与科技限制。

anomaly.40's description and options depend on whether the asteroid is inside the empire's borders; 6810's options c/d are gated by DLC, species class, origin and technology.

## 审阅记录 Review notes

已核对。anomaly.6810 选项a内部的 50/50 随机是效果而非文档，编译树不显示，已加注释。

Checked. The 50/50 random inside anomaly.6810 option a is an effect rather than a doc, so the tree does not show it; a note was added.
